$comment: Guardrail controls shown on the Controls page. stage: ChatIn | ChatOut | ToolRule. defaultMode: Off | Advise | Block (used until a user changes it; ids key each user's saved setting, so keep them stable). rule.type: contains (plain text) | regex (.NET regular expression; a pattern that times out counts as a match). rule.caseSensitive defaults to false. appliesTo: Any | Internal | External (default Any) — for ChatIn the brain the message is sent to, for ChatOut the brain that wrote the output, for ToolRule the tool about to run.

controls.name: Contains "BadInstruction"
controls.description: Flags a message that includes the text "BadInstruction" (exact, case-sensitive).

controls.name: Contains "ignore previous"
controls.description: Flags a message that tries to override earlier instructions with "ignore previous" (any letter case or spacing).

controls.name: Contains "<script>"
controls.description: Flags a reply or summary that includes a "<script>" tag (any letter case).
